title: Rename a song
prompt: Song is supplied. Rename(Song song, string title) should return a copy of the song with the new title. Its Id and Liked must stay the same. The starter returns the song unchanged.
hints: Which of the three values changes, and which two must be carried over?
with copies every value you do not mention.
checks: Practice.Rename(new Song(1, "Intro", false), "Finale") == new Song(1, "Finale", false)
Practice.Rename(new Song(7, "Intro", true), "Finale") == new Song(7, "Finale", true)
Practice.Rename(new Song(2, "Intro", false), "") == new Song(2, "", false)
checkLabels: Renaming song 1 to Finale must give song 1 with the title Finale.
A liked song must still be liked, with the same Id, after renaming.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Builds a fresh record and resets Liked.
Treats a rename as a new song and drops the Id.

feedback: Compare all three values of the failing result with the song that went in. Only the title should differ.
